steps: Peel and dice the onion; mince the garlic; trim and slice the zucchini into 1 cm rounds.
Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic; cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until softened and translucent.
Stir in the cumin and turmeric; cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the zucchini, drained cooked chickpeas, coconut milk, and unsalted vegetable broth.
Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 12 to 15 minutes, until zucchini is very tender.
Remove from heat and blend with an immersion blender until smooth and creamy.
Ladle into bowls and check texture is fully smooth before serving to young children.
Yields about 1.4 litres · 4 family portions. Refrigerate for up to 3 days or freeze in portions for up to 2 months.
